english.title: User of watercraft endanger watercraft / ship / structure / individual
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE STATEMENT OF FACTS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 6 of the Merchant Shipping (Watercraft) Order 2023 and section 58(2) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) Article 6 of the Merchant Shipping (Watercraft) Order 2023 provides for the application of section 58 to watercraft. This ensures that the offences in section 58 apply to users of watercraft as they do in relation to ships; for the offence wording regarding ships see H16067.
(ii) Section 58(6) provides defences to this offence.
(iii) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Secretary of State or the Director of Public Prosecutions, see section 58(7).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
